title: Black Cherry: Champion Trees to Visit
meta_description: A big eastern North American forest cherry. Cook County's champions reach 34.7 m, and Wisconsin's state champion stands 32 m tall.
intro: Prunus serotina is a forest tree, and the champions on our map are measured, not guessed. Wisconsin's register ranks the black cherry at the Kettle Moraine headquarters its state's biggest, 32 metres tall with a trunk 2.74 metres round. In Cook County, Illinois, the forest preserves' register puts the biggest at Camp Ground Road Woods with a trunk 3.35 metres round, and the tallest at Swallow Cliff Woods, 34.7 metres. The third-ranked, at Callahan Grove, is 21.9 metres tall with a trunk 2.63 metres round.
